On a mostly uniform grid with scattered single-cell markers (the marker color differs from the background), find pairs of markers of the same color that lie in the same row or column. Fill the intervening cells on the straight horizontal/vertical segment with color 3. Keep the marker endpoints, the original background, and all other cells unchanged. Demo 1/2 show the same behavior with other marker colors/backgrounds. A line is only the interval between aligned markers, not a ray extending outward.

Input: 5×25, background 4, marker 8 at zero-based coordinates `(0,8), (1,12), (1,14), (2,5), (3,15), (4,15)`.
